purpose: Validate that each property fixture governance snapshot is complete, internally coherent, immutable and separated from legal evidence and publication decisions.

checks.name: Snapshot identity
checks.requirement: Snapshot has a unique identifier and capture date.

checks.name: Governance reference
checks.requirement: Snapshot identifies the governance manifest on which its state is based.

checks.name: State completeness
checks.requirement: Fixture, dependency, impact, revalidation, closure, audit, legal-source, evidence and publication states are represented.

checks.name: Record traceability
checks.requirement: Snapshot references the material fixture, impact, queue, validation and governance records.

checks.name: Immutability
checks.requirement: Snapshot is treated as historical and cannot be silently overwritten.

checks.name: Legal-source separation
checks.requirement: Snapshot does not convert technical governance status into legal verification.

checks.name: Publication separation
checks.requirement: Snapshot does not independently make a pathway publication-ready.

guardrails: It does not verify Irish property law.
It does not represent live official-record retrieval.
It does not upgrade any pathway to publication-ready.
